statement: Pinned rnconrad device-side emulator interprets extension register offset 0xF0 writes of 0xAA as enabling encrypted communication and 0x55 as disabling it in its ordinary extension path. However, when MotionPlus is active (wmp_state == 1), writes addressed to the 0xA4 bank are routed into the 0xA6 MotionPlus register bank, and a 0x55 write at 0xF0 takes an earlier MotionPlus deactivation/status-transition branch. Therefore the ordinary 0xF0 encryption-toggle rule does not apply unconditionally during active MotionPlus.

applicability.revision: Historical software emulator; physical Wii extension revision not established
applicability.scope: wiimote.c 394-452: register pointer selection at 405-408, active MotionPlus deactivation at 410-423, ordinary encryption toggle 442-452. This is historical emulator interpretation, not physical validation.
